description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the FormatWithCompetency class within the OrangeHRM maintenance plugin. The test verifies the formatted values for various competency levels, utilizing test data populated from a YAML fixture file.

classes.name: FormatWithCompetencyTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for testing the FormatWithCompetency class's getFormattedValue method.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, loads fixture data, and creates an instance of FormatWithCompetency.

methods.name: testGetFormattedValue
methods.description: Tests that the getFormattedValue method returns the correct string representations for competency levels 1 through 4.
